_comment: T14 efficacy A/B — PLACEBO arm settings.
MEASUREMENT CONTROL — NOT A PRODUCTION FAKE.
This settings file is an explicitly-labeled experimental control in the T14
A/B harness. It injects matched-token-mass IRRELEVANT skill context (from a
mismatched scope/corpus path) so that any benefit of the ON arm can be
separated from 'any extra context helps' vs 'relevant skills help'.
The server is still the REAL mcp-server (http://127.0.0.1:3001); the mismatch
is achieved via the scope/repo_path pointing at a directory that has a
separately-managed corpus of deliberately mismatched skills. This is NOT a
silent fallback — it is a labeled A/B control arm and must be recorded as such
in every run report.
If no placebo corpus exists, the harness must fail loud rather than silently
serve the correct corpus. The operator must provision the placebo corpus before
running a live efficacy sweep.
PLACEBO_CORPUS_PATH env var overrides the repo_path argument sent to compile_context.
Default: a nonexistent path that will cause the server to return no_match for
every query, making the arm effectively 'zero irrelevant context' — which is the
conservative placebo (safest control). A richer placebo (real but mismatched skills)
can be configured by setting PLACEBO_CORPUS_PATH to a directory with a different
project's skill corpus.
Interpretation: if PLACEBO arm performs similarly to ON, the benefit comes from
'any extra context' not from 'skill-layer-relevant skills' — a negative signal for T12.
